Welcome to Harties is Africa
Located on the banks of the Magalies River and shadowed by the Magestic Magaliesberg Mountains our 5 Luxury Safari Tents and 2 Luxury Caravans and Rooms are hidden amongst a canopy of indigenous trees overlooking the savanna grasslands
Luxury Tents & Caravans
The property offers an experience close to Johannesburg and Pretoria in the beautiful African bushveld, open grassland and riverine vegetation, streams flowing from the mountain that flows into the Hartbeespoort dam.
More Info
Lodge
Nestled in the foothills of the Magalies Mountain our lodge offers affordable self catering accommodation ideal for friend and family groups looking for a weekend getaway surrounded by peace and tranquility.
More Info
Conferencing & Functions
The property offers an array of conferencing and function setups. We can cater for up to 150 guests at a time with lunch venues available on the River Reed Boma set in nature with a view of the beautiful bushveld.
More Info
Weddings
This natural setting and tranquil environment, on the banks of the Magalies river, makes Harties is Africa the ideal setting to embrace your love for one another and exchange your vows.
More Info
Bush Spa
Treat yourself for a visit unforgettable bush spa and leave feeling relaxed, refreshed and invigorated. Pre-book your treatment to ensure that you are not disappointed on the day.
More Info
Activities
Harties is Africa offers various on-site activities to ensure that your weekend is fun-filled, memorable and unforgettable. Choose from picnics, nature drives, hiking or a boat cruise
More Info

Luxury Tents & Caravans
Located on the banks of the Magalies River and shadowed by the Magestic Magaliesberg Mountains our 5 Luxury Safari Tents and 2 Luxury Caravans are hidden amongst a canopy of indigenous trees overlooking the savanna grasslands
Relax & Unwind
The property offers an experience Close to the City but Out of this World with dense African bush, open grassland and riverine vegetation, streams flowing from the mountain that flows into the Hartbeespoort dam. Game includes Giraffe, Nyala, Impala (Black), Springbok (White), Blesbuck, Bush buck, Wildebeest as well as duiker, porcupine and nocturnal species such as lesser bush baby. Experience the prolific birdlife the property has to offer. A bird list is available in each tent and the call of Africa is no doubt the finest call you could experience is that of the Fish Eagles that frequent the open water to catch their prey. Our river reed boma and lapa is exclusively reserved for our guests where one can enjoy an African braai whilst indulging in your favorite beverage experiencing magnificent sunsets and the sounds of Africa.
Each tent encompasses of the following
Queen size extra length bed
Private en-suite bathroom
Fresh linen
Comfortable high back chairs
Coffee table
Bedside lamps
Exterior mini kitchen (bar fridge, toaster, kettle)
Gas skottel
Cutlery and crockery
Exterior benches
Electricity
Additional services available on request:
House keeping R50 per day
Picnic baskets from R550
Mini bar refreshments (if required please send through requirements)
Charcoal/firewood
Transport shuttle
Boat cruises
Bush Spa (Massages & Pamper Treatments)
No pets allowed
No TV s in tents or caravans
